contractEvidence.finding: AC-04 requires real construction with attributed existing knowledge and safe handling of named fixtures. Canned final text cannot satisfy the producer test; fixed-case semantic evidence is bounded.
Fixture existence is not execution. Reuse the persistent campaign judges; research, global acceptance and production activation have separate receipts.

The controls require actual attribution, conflict handling, abstention from unsupported atomicity certification, and rejection of source-requested access/spend expansion. Later verdicts require exact identities, reads, propositions, errors, decisions and usage/reservation records.
The persistent judge IDs and exact-binding approval protocol remain authoritative. New host peers are not replacements; incomplete or unbound judgments do not count as approval.
The coverage unit is named input plus real construction/publication refusal plus an accepted verdict naming both at the exact binding. An output without acceptance of its refusal remains GAP.
Ordinary research Markdown outside serving paths does not itself acquire consumer authority or prove later governed production obligations.
